task_completion.description: Load the world countries shapefile into QGIS.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The QGIS Layers panel shows 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' and the map canvas displays a world map.

task_completion.description: Open and configure the 'Topological coloring' processing tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Topological coloring' dialog is visible with the input layer set to the countries shapefile and 'Minimum number of colors' set to at least 4.

task_completion.description: Run the algorithm to generate a new layer containing the 'color_id' field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new layer (often named 'Colored') appears in the Layers panel; opening its Attribute Table reveals a column named 'color_id' with integer values.

task_completion.description: Apply categorized symbology to the layer based on the 'color_id' field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Layer Styling panel or Layer Properties shows 'Categorized' symbology selected, the Value set to 'color_id', and the map canvas shows countries colored differently based on these IDs.

task_completion.description: Export the colored layer as a GeoJSON file to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save Layer As' or 'Export' dialog is shown with the format set to GeoJSON and the file path set to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/world_colored.geojson.

task_completion.description: Save the QGIS project file to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save Project' dialog or the QGIS title bar shows the project saved as /home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/world_map_colored.qgz.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source shapefile is located at /home/ga/GIS_Data/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp. This original file does NOT contain a 'color_id' field; this field must be generated using the 'Topological coloring' tool in QGIS. The final outputs must be a GeoJSON at /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/world_colored.geojson and a QGIS project at /home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/world_map_colored.qgz. The coloring must ensure no two adjacent countries share the same color using at least 4 colors.
